name: Camping Hochzillertal
beschreibung: Camping Hochzillertal is located in Kaltenbach in the Zillertal valley and is classified as a campsite. The resort is situated right at the foot of the cable car of the same name, making it an ideal base for outdoor adventures in both winter and summer. The site offers designated pitch zones for motorhomes, caravans, and tents, complete with comprehensive electricity and water hookups. Sanitary facilities and convenient shopping options are available on the premises. In the vicinity, guests can explore the renowned Hochzillertal ski resort or enjoy an abundance of scenic summer hiking trails.
